messages:
mel_marketing: Hey @sam_runtime — we need a tiny smoke run to validate some bench numbers for next week's launch post. Goal: 1) confirm quantized int8 cold-start and warmup delta, 2) capture embedding latencies for 512 & 2048 contexts, and 3) surface any tail errors. Can you help with a small pack? Link to proposed payloads: https://redwood.ai/bench-proto :pray:
sam_runtime: Yep. Can you attach the exact payloads and desired warmup profile? Prefer a tiny cohort (50 requests) for quick run. Also do you want batching on/off?
mel_marketing: Attaching gist -- includes 50 requests split 70/30 short/long. Warmup: 20 init calls using 0.8 concurrency. Turn batching off for cold-start measurement, then run batching=auto for throughput snapshot. Also include quantized-int8 and fp16 variants.
mel_marketing: Payload example:
```
{"prompt": "Summarize the following: <article text>", "max_tokens": 256}
```
Also we need embed call sample:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{"input": "<doc>", "model": "redwood-embedding-2"}
```
(We care about p95/p99 for embeds.)
sam_runtime: OK. I'll do: coldstart no-batch int8, coldstart no-batch fp16, warmup then batch auto int8, batch auto fp16, embed 512 & 2048 contexts. Expect ~30-45m including setup. Any constraints on tagging/trace ids?
mel_marketing: Please tag with campaign:launch-apr25 and add header X-Trace: mk-<ticket>. We also need a brief JSON artifact listing runtime config and raw latencies.
john_eng: Heads up — if the int8 model falls back on missing kernels, add a fallback to fp16 and note it in the artifact. We've seen a kernel mismatch on A100 drivers earlier.
sam_runtime: Noted. I'll capture fallback events and include a short log snippet. Also will post the artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/launch-apr25/ and ping here when done.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: bench-runner-image:v3.4 starting in worker cluster-3.
mel_marketing: Amazing, thank you. Can you also grab one sample full trace for an outlier p99 request (include tokens and model response) — redact PII if any? :eyes: 
sam_runtime: Will do. Linking when complete.
